title: Mark only affected slide decisions out of date
preconditions: Two review slides have current decisions and each owns different code evidence.

steps.action: Change code linked to one decided slide and refresh the review.
steps.expected_result: Only that slide decision becomes out of date while the unaffected slide stays current.

steps.action: Revise a decided slide without changing the other slide.
steps.expected_result: Only the revised slide decision becomes out of date.

steps.action: Inspect the decision records and reviewed heads.
steps.expected_result: The old decisions remain visible with their reviewed head and explicit currency reason.

expected_result: Pass when slide and code changes invalidate only the affected decision while preserving its history; fail on global invalidation, silent replacement, or missing reviewed head.
